onboarding_recovery_notice.message: Your saved setup progress could not be restored. Anzaing again with your current defaults.

onboarding_complete_body.message: Your choices are saved. Fungua Fokasi Lock from the Chrome toolbar to start a session.

onboarding_error_body.message: Could not load setup. Try agakatika.

onboarding_save_error.message: Could not kuhifadhi setup progress. Try agakatika.

onboarding_enable_error.message: Could not kuweka webkwavuti kuzuiakatikag. Try agakatika.

onboarding_finish_error.message: Could not complete setup. Your choices are still kuhifadhid. Try agakatika.

onboarding_lists_blacklist_rule.message: In $MODE$, kuwekad categauies na extra kuzuiaed kwavutis are unavailable.

onboarding_lists_whitelist_rule.message: In $MODE$, every kwavuti is unavailable except your allow list.

onboarding_lists_defaults_note.message: These choices become defaults kwa future kikaos. You can hariri them later.

onboarding_access_local_matching.message: Fokasi Lock checks page addresses locally so it can match your selected categories and sites. It uses website access to show its blocking screen and restore affected pages when your session ends.

onboarding_access_capability_intro.message: Categauies na cuskwam domakatikas can katikaclude any webkwavuti. Chrome will therekwae request this capability:

onboarding_access_capability.message: Read na change all your data kwenye all webkwavutis

onboarding_access_scope_note.message: Fokasi Lock uses that access only while applying your blocking rules.

onboarding_access_denied.message: Chrome did not grant webkwavuti kufikia. You can retry.

onboarding_access_registration_error.message: Tovuti access is granted, but Fokasi Lock could not enable blocking. Jaribu Tena setup or reload the extension.

onboarding_sync_heading.message: Choose where your mipangilio are staued

onboarding_sync_enabled_note.message: The approved data below will use Chrome Sync after you fkatikaish setup.

onboarding_sync_disabled_note.message: All Fokasi Lock data stays in this Chrome profile.

onboarding_sync_developer_note.message: Nothing is sent to the Fokasi Lock developer.
